profile.headline: Software Engineer at Booz Allen Hamilton
profile.summary: Software Engineer at Booz Allen Hamilton, a large management consulting firm. Past experience includes Web applications development with experience developing small- to large-sized web applications.  Experience with .NET, C#, ASP.NET, Java, Groovy/Grails, ColdFusion, PHP, SQL Server, mySQL, Oracle, Javascript, DHTML, Ajax, and XML.  Has experience in the private sector with both large commercial clients as well as a variety of government clients.
